nodes.description: Private mapping(address=>uint256) counting how many sales each address has performed; incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist checked in ensure; never assigned outside internal logic.
Private minimum sale value set by init and enforced in condition.
Private maximum sale value set by init and enforced in condition.
Private global sale limit per address set by init and enforced in condition.
Address whitelisted in ensure; writable by owner through setTradeAddress.
Public mapping of token balances; mutated with raw unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of allowances; debited with raw unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
Public constant decimal precision (18) used for supply scaling.
Public total token supply fixed at construction.
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Private privileged address set to msg.sender; gates delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address whitelisted in ensure.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal view gate that returns true for owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/whitelisted senders and otherwise requires condition(); whitelist bypasses sale limits.
Public payable transferFrom; debits allowance with raw subtraction, calls ensure, then mutates balanceOf with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approval writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale constraints per sender.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch distribution using unchecked multiplication and subtraction of balances.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
Internal pure Uniswap V2 pair address derivation via keccak256 create2 computation.
Payable constructor minting the whole supply to msg.sender and granting infinite allowance to the router.
External caller identity used for ownership checks, allowance bookkeeping and balance ownership.
Arbitrary delegatecall in delegate() executing untrusted code in the contract storage context.
Raw allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath; protected only by the preceding require.
Raw balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath.
Raw total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total without overflow protection.

edges.reason: _to parameter flows into transfer which forwards it to transferFrom.
_value parameter flows into transfer.
msg.sender is used as the _from argument of the internal transferFrom call.
transfer invokes transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
_from is compared against the owner, UNI, tradeAddress and whitelist entries.
_to is compared against owner and UNI inside ensure.
_value is forwarded from ensure to condition.
owner state variable is read in the ensure whitelist branch.
UNI constant is read in the ensure whitelist branch.
tradeAddress state variable is read in the ensure whitelist branch.
canSale mapping is read in the ensure whitelist branch.
Locally computed pair address _UNI is compared inside ensure.
ensure calls condition(_from,_value) when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure calls pairFor to compute the pair address for the whitelist check.
_from address flows into transferFrom for debit.
_to address flows into transferFrom for credit.
_value amount flows into transferFrom.
msg.sender must match _from or a sufficient allowance must exist.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) to succeed.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is read and decremented inside transferFrom.
balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] are read and written inside transferFrom.
_onSaleNum[_from] is incremented after each successful transfer.
transferFrom executes the raw allowance subtraction operation.
transferFrom executes the raw balanceOf mutation operations.
allowance storage slot is the operand of the unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf storage slots are operands of the unchecked add/sub.
_spender parameter flows into approve.
_value parameter flows into approve.
msg.sender is the owner key of the allowance entry written by approve.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
_from is used to read _onSaleNum in condition.
_value is compared against _minSale and _maxSale in condition.
_saleNum is the per-address sale limit read by condition.
_minSale is the lower bound read by condition.
_maxSale is the upper bound read by condition.
_onSaleNum[_from] is compared against _saleNum in condition.
Target address a is supplied by the owner to delegate.
Arbitrary calldata b is supplied to delegate.
delegate is restricted by require(msg.sender == owner).
delegate performs the low-level delegatecall to an owner-chosen target.
The delegatecall target address a is fully attacker/owner controlled.
The delegatecall calldata b is fully attacker/owner controlled.
The delegatecall executes external code in this contract's context and can re-enter its state-changing functions.
saleNum parameter is assigned to _saleNum in init.
token parameter is scaled into _minSale in init.
maxToken parameter is scaled into _maxSale in init.
init is restricted by require(msg.sender == owner).
init writes the _minSale state variable.
init writes the _maxSale state variable.
init writes the _saleNum state variable.
_tos array drives the batchSend loop.
_value is the per-recipient amount in batchSend.
batchSend is restricted by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend reads and mutates balanceOf[msg.sender] and each recipient balance.
batchSend computes total and deducts it without SafeMath.
Local total is the operand of the unchecked subtraction.
total is used to gate and perform the balance deduction.
Loop counter i controls iteration over _tos.
Current recipient _to receives balanceOf credit inside the loop.
addr parameter is assigned to tradeAddress.
setTradeAddress is restricted by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress state variable.
factory address feeds the create2 pair computation.
tokenA feeds the create2 pair computation.
tokenB feeds the create2 pair computation.
Sorted token0 is hashed into the pair address.
Sorted token1 is hashed into the pair address.
pair is the returned value derived from the create2 hash.
_name parameter is stored as the token name.
_symbol parameter is stored as the token symbol.
_supply parameter is scaled into totalSupply.
msg.sender becomes owner and receives the entire initial supply.
constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
constructor sets totalSupply from _supply.
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
constructor grants infinite allowance to the Uniswap router.
constructor stores the token name.
constructor stores the token symbol.
